steps.content: An hour ago...
The familiar feeling of suffocating dread hits you.
You feel as if someone has dragged you into the pool again. You're unable to move your hands and feet.
All you can do is watch the air escape from your mouth bit by bit, before vanishing completely...
You wake up with a start, panting heavily. Sweat soaks your hair and trickles down your forehead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where... where am I...
You're... on my plate...
The hazy feeling soon dissipates. You come back to your senses and look around.
You're in a dark room lit by dim candlelight.
You're lying on an elegant white tablecloth, surrounded by circles of beautiful purple flowers and sliced-open pomegranates and figs.
A stream of rosy juice is spreading on the tablecloth. It seems to be flowing from your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cabernet?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... what are you doing?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: (Chuckles) So you noticed that it's me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I recognize your voice... plus your Mania.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah. No wonder you're the MBCC's Chief... How very clever.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're so very... kind, yet unconstrained by the "rules"...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I like you so much... So much so that I want to gobble you down in one bite... I held myself back from getting a taste of you until now...
Your hands and feet are bound. You can only look at Cabernet with your head tilted back.
You see her voracious mouth and gluttonous eyes.
Her knife and fork can barely wait to cut out a delicious grape from your consciousness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... you planned and controlled this feast the whole time?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: No... it wasn't all me.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I simply went along with poor McGrath after she said she'll give me an unforgettable feast... and helped her a bit along the way.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: After all... I've been hungry for too long...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's just that she's too stubborn and stupid... She doesn't really know what a truly shining soul is like...
Cabernet puts down her knife and fork, leans over you and kisses your hair.
Her sweat-stained lips glisten in the candlelight.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Watching those caged by rules... either get crushed by labels, or break free from the cage...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You... all of you... shone so brightly in the most precarious moments!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ahh... How delicious you are!
Cabernet gently lifts up your head, letting you see the rows of transparent boxes under the light.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Kelvin?! And... Macchiato!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are they here?!
You can see that Kelvin and Macchiato are still breathing. But the people in the boxes next to them sends a chill down your back...
It's the two you had defeated just now, that "mermaid" whom McGrath regards as a failure... they are, the treasured ingredients stolen from Cabernet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you going to eat them?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: She stood up for the weak despite being terrified herself... and used her exquisite culinary hands to cut up a corpse to protect us...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: She really is a good girl... Like I said, she's like a tempting bowl of fruit-flavored shaved ice, refreshing and sweet...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And her...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: She can easily perceive what others yearn for... Even if that means picking at her own scars, she's willing to do it to comfort others...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Just like her name, she adds a sweet, wonderous and unforgettable flavor to people's lives...
Cabernet speaks vividly, as if she can already taste the delicacies she's describing.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: McGrath doesn't understand them at all. She thinks that one is a coward and the other is a hedonist...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: That's why I kept them!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah... The purest, most instinctive impulse...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know what you do to your ingredients... you make them into hollow shells.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm the winner of this game. I should be the one you want to "eat" most, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come at me if you must. Leave them alone.
Cabernet stares at you, a bit surprised at first, then full of glee and desire.
She lunges at you bluntly and feverishly.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Yes... yes! Exactly! This is what I want!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're the most delicious!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Whether in the game or in the face of powerful enemies, you never fail to surprise me.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: From the moment you appeared, I knew you'd be the final victor of this game! You're the tastiest of them all!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Even though I helped you deal with a couple of messes along the way...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But in the end, you still managed to become the winner!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ah... I know I can't stop myself from seeking delicious food!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Those poor kids. They ended up like this because of my unbridled actions... Their flavors have become much weaker...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But I know... You are different...
Cabernet clasps your hand tightly and presses it to her cheek.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're really impressive. In fact, I only used my grapes on you in the swimming pool. Since then, you've been trudging forward, and now you're the final victor...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's thanks to your own ideas, actions, and abilities...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And after overcoming all the hardships of the game... your soul is brighter, tastier, and more attractive to me than ever...! You're still growing, ${PlayerName}.
Her soft skin and warm touch, and the trembling of muscles as she speaks, all pass through your palm into your nerves.
You want to take your hand out of her grasp and flee, but she clutches on even tighter.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Ha... Don't be afraid. Don't try to flee... I now know how to take care of a treasure like you. I'll protect you and help you, so that I can enjoy you slowly...
Cabernet is still holding onto your hand and gazing at you gently, but you feel the Mania strengthening. Things are getting out of your control!
The sound of her heartbeat grows louder and clearer. You fully understand that this is a powerful, insatiable Sinner before you.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Don't worry... I'm just going to take one bite. It'll be like a kiss.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Think of it as a kiss...
Cabernet takes your hand, puts it to her lips, and kisses the beating pulse of your wrist.
Her hot, humid breath sweeps by you. You feel a certain essence slowly leaving your body, and your vision begins to blur!
The next second, you see a crystal-clear grape in Cabernet's mouth. She bites it gently, and the rich juice flows down the corner of her mouth, trickling past her beauty mark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your power incapacitates people... I... I have the obligation to...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...to restrain... and detain you...
Cabernet chuckles. She licks away the lingering juice on her lips and tongue, savoring the sweet taste.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Shackles are indeed powerful... my dear Chief...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But a Sinner's power comes from their heart...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: My heart... is filled with the desire for delicious food and "souls."

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I hope that the growth of your power can catch up with... the expansion of my desires.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: When that time comes... I shall willingly be at your mercy... and follow you to the ends of the Earth.
You understand the meaning behind Cabernet's words. You want to cast your shackles to stop her from leaving—but you realize you can't!
The peeling away of your soul makes you mentally and physically unable to support yourself. You can only watch as Cabernet leaves with a satisfied look on her face...
"I look forward to your continued growth, my most precious 'treasure'."
